items.text: Oneoftheearliest andbestknownusesofphenolwasinantisepticsurgery,especiallybythe surgeon Joseph Lister.Since then,other antiseptics have been developed fromphenol. One of the most familiar of these is the product of the chlorination of phenol - this is 2,4,6-trichlorophenol, better known as the antiseptic TCP. Nowadays, phenol is widely used in many industries, notably in themanufacture ofpolymers andpharmaceuticals.
